briefdescription.para: Serves MCP tool calls over standard input for one manifest.

detaileddescription.para: The relay exposes the declared tools through an MCP server and translates each call into a request row. It queues cancel rows for cancelled requests. Each daemon reply goes back to the MCP caller as a tool result or a tool error. Daemon showMessage notifications update the model message.
